hero.subtitle: Data-leak protection with screen, file and print watermarks, plus screen and application control, so sensitive information always carries its owner.

challenge.title: The challenge in KSA
challenge.body: Most leaks happen inside: a phone photo of a screen, a printout left on a desk, a screen shared in the wrong meeting, a file forwarded to the wrong person or a screen left unlocked. Legacy DLP, classification and rights-management tools leave gaps at the application and screen level.
points: Phone cameras bypass every network control
Printouts and PDF exports leave no trace
Screen sharing exposes data in virtual meetings
Investigations stall without proof of who leaked what

opportunity.title: The opportunity
opportunity.body: When every screen, file and printout visibly carries who, where and when, people think twice before leaking, and investigators can trace a copy back to its source in minutes.

capabilities.title: Screen watermark
capabilities.body: A visible watermark over the whole screen or only over chosen applications.

capabilities.title: Automatic file watermarks
capabilities.body: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files watermarked automatically, with integrity monitoring.

capabilities.title: Print watermarks
capabilities.body: Every printout and PDF export carries the user and device.

capabilities.title: Screen control
capabilities.body: Blocks unauthorized screen sharing and screenshots of critical applications; every attempt is logged.

capabilities.title: Application control
capabilities.body: Blocks unauthorized apps, snipping tools and PrintScreen, with user warnings and timestamped logs.

capabilities.title: Governed exceptions
capabilities.body: Users request exceptions through an approval workflow with a full audit trail.

applications.title: Board papers and M&A data rooms
applications.body: Protect the most sensitive strategy and deal documents.

applications.title: Tender documents and engineering designs
applications.body: Trace any copy of commercial or technical IP.

applications.title: Patient records
applications.body: Deter screen photos and printouts of clinical data.

applications.title: Classified government files
applications.body: Make every on-screen and printed copy traceable to a user and device.

applications.title: Bank customer data
applications.body: Protect customer information in branches and back offices.

applications.title: HR files
applications.body: Keep salary, performance and personal records accountable.

outcomes.label: Traceable to a user and device

vision2030.body: Protecting government and enterprise data builds the trust that digital government, investment and data-driven services depend on.

deployment.note: Management console and logs run on your premises or in-Kingdom; agents run on your endpoints.
